text:
kevin: Hey team — we need to lock a 60m design review for the new API/SDK/Console flow (model routing + auth + telemetry). Pre-read is here: https://redwood-internal/docs/designs/routing-sdk-console-preflight (please skim). Can people +1 availability and any must-have agenda items?

maria: +1 for Thurs morning (09:30 PT) if that works. I'll bring the API contract draft.

jon: Thurs 09:30 PT is OK for me. Request: add a short perf expectations section (p99 latency targets + batching implications).

tara: I can do Thurs but prefer 11:00 PT. Also want to cover rollout guardrails — canary vs. progressive rollout checklist.

kevin: Noted — perf + rollout guardrails added to agenda. Options: Thu 09:30 PT (api-first owners) or Thu 11:00 PT (infra + SRE can join). Which do folks prefer?

maria: If infra/SRE need to attend, 11:00 PT is better. Otherwise 09:30 is fine.

jon: 11:00 PT works; I want ~10m to show simple perf microbenchmarks and a 5‑min question slot.

kevin: ok locking Thu 11:00 PT as tentative. Agenda draft: 1) 5m intro+goals 2) 15m API contract walkthrough 3) 10m SDK integration surface + examples 4) 15m Console UX flows + mockups 5) 10m rollout/perf/telemetry Q&A. Any other asks?

tara: add a quick 'fallback strategy' slide — what happens if dedicated pool is saturated (routing fallback to smaller model).

jon: also include the suggested trace/event names for telemetry so we can align console metrics.

kevin: good callouts — added fallback + trace names. Action items before the review: - @maria: update API doc with example request/response (small sample). - @jon: attach perf microbenchmark gist. - @tara: write 3 rollout scenarios (canary, gradual, emergency fallback). Please post by Wed EOD.

dev-bot: calendar: Created provisional event "Design review: Routing + SDK + Console" Thu 11:00 PT — invite sent to kevin, maria, jon, tara, eng-runtime.ics

sre-bot: heads up — maintenance window planned Thu 10:45-11:15 PT in us-west-2 for infra upgrades. Might affect participation or cause flakiness. Recommend shifting to 12:00 PT if we want SRE fully present.

kevin: ah — thanks @sre-bot. Given that, propose moving to Thu 12:00 PT to avoid overlap. Can everyone confirm fast?

maria: 12:00 PT works for me.

jon: works for me too.

tara: ok for 12:00 PT.

kevin: Finalized: Thu 12:00 PT. I'll update the calendar and the pre-read with the final agenda + links. Thanks all — please push those artifacts by Wed EOD so we can prep the slides. :thumbsup:
